description: List recent bookings for this API key, newest first. Returns shipments across all channels and all time, including cancelled — a broader population than shipper_profile's counts (agent-API bookings over the last 180 days, excluding cancelled), so the totals can differ. Auth required. Renders an interactive shipments card (click a shipment to expand pickup/delivery, freight, and a tracking link).
name: list_bookings
title: List Bookings
